articles.summary: Growth accelerated with 41K voluntary new business policies sold in the third quarter, up 57% year-over-year, compared to 54% year-over-year growth in the second quarter of 2026 Record 83% growth in revenue in the third quarter year-over year $39.6 million of income before income taxes, one of the most profitable quarters in our history Gross premiums written grew 23% year-over-year to $293 million during the quarter Net premiums earned of $101 million, up 95% year-over-year, nearly double the same period last year American Integrity Insurance Group, Inc. (“American Integrity,” “we,” “us,” “our” or the “Company”) (NYSE: AII), reported third quarter 2026 results. Robert Ritchie, Chief Executive Officer, commented, “We delivered another strong quarter that reflects the continued execution of our strategy and the increasing strength of our voluntary growth platform. articles.title: American Integrity Insurance Group, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
